# Tabs

> One row of tabs that switches panels in the same place: large tabs that head a view, compact tabs inside a card.

Part of the [Nate Mills Design System](../README.md). It is a CSS class API, not a JavaScript component, so its props are the classes and HTML attributes below. Link the stylesheets as [Getting started](../foundations/getting-started.md) shows, then add the classes. Every component: [Components](../COMPONENTS.md).

## When to use

- Two or more panels of related content that share one place on the page, such as Tokens, CSS and JSON views of one card.
- A view that switches between sibling sections, such as the components in a playground.

## When not to use

- Picking a slide in a carousel: use the Carousel navigation, a group of buttons.
- Switching a view mode such as List and Gallery: that is a segmented control, a radio group.
- Moving to another page: use a Link.

## Alternatives

- **[Carousel navigation](carousel-navigation.md):** Tabs swap panels in place; the carousel navigation moves along a track of cards. If the content scrolls sideways, it is a carousel.
- **[Button](button.md):** A tab selects a panel and stays selected; a Button runs an action once.

## How to use

**Element:** A `role="tablist"` container with an `aria-label`, holding `<button type="button" role="tab">` tabs, each tied to a `role="tabpanel"`.

- Put `.tabs` and one size, `.tabs--lg` or `.tabs--compact`, on the `role="tablist"` row.
- Put `.tab` on each `<button type="button" role="tab">`, with `aria-selected`, `aria-controls` and an `id` the panel names in `aria-labelledby`.
- Drive it with a script that moves focus with the arrow keys, Home and End, keeps one Tab stop, and shows the chosen panel.

**Classes:** `.tabs`, `.tabs--lg`, `.tabs--compact`, `.tab`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Allowed values | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | modifier class | `lg` (`.tabs--lg`), `compact` (`.tabs--compact`) | None: pick one size; `.tabs` alone has no tab look. | How large the tabs are and how the selected one is marked. |
| `aria-selected` | attribute, boolean | `true` on the chosen tab, `false` on the rest | None. Required on every tab. | Marks the chosen tab; the CSS reads it for the selected look. |
| `aria-controls` | attribute, id reference | The `id` of the tab's panel | None. Required on every tab. | Ties the tab to the panel it shows. |
| `icon` | child element | A leading Lucide `<i data-lucide="..." aria-hidden="true">` | None. | Optional, on compact tabs; the word carries the meaning. |

## Variants

Available sizes: `lg`, `compact`.

- `lg` (`.tabs--lg`): Display-face tabs that head a whole view; the page draws the selected bar.
- `compact` (`.tabs--compact`): Mono caption tabs inside a card, each drawing its own underline when selected, at least 48px tall.

Default size: None: pick one size; `.tabs` alone has no tab look.

## States

| State | What changes | Tokens |
|---|---|---|
| `default` | Tertiary text, no fill. The chosen tab (`aria-selected="true"`) is primary text; a compact one adds a 2px accent underline, a large one sits over the bar the page draws. | `--color-text-tertiary`, `--color-text-primary` |
| `hover` | The text steps to primary. | `--color-text-primary` |
| `focus-visible` | The system ring drawn inside the tab, so a scrolling row never clips it. | `--border-focus` |

The CSS styles these pseudo-classes: `:focus-visible`, `:hover`.

## Invalid combinations

Options that must not be used together. Each names the props above.

| Combination | Level | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `.tabs--lg` with `.tabs--compact` | MUST NOT | A row takes one size. |
| `.tab` on an `<a>` that loads another page | MUST NOT | Tabs swap panels in place; moving to another page is a Link. |
| `.tabs` holding carousel slide pickers | MUST NOT | A carousel picker is a group of buttons (Carousel navigation). |

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
|---|---|
| Tab | Moves into the row on the chosen tab, then on to its panel. |
| Left arrow, Right arrow | Move to the previous or next tab and show its panel, wrapping at the ends. |
| Home, End | Move to the first or last tab and show its panel. |

The published CSS draws the tabs; the behaviour comes from the script that drives them. natemills.me's tablist script follows the W3C APG tabs pattern with automatic activation.

## Rules

| Level | Rule | Checked by |
|---|---|---|
| MUST | Mark the row `role="tablist"` with an `aria-label`, each tab `role="tab"` with `aria-selected`, and each panel `role="tabpanel"`. | [Automated: axe accessibility scan](../foundations/checks.md#axe-accessibility-scan) |
| MUST | Keep one Tab stop on the row and move between tabs with the arrow keys. | [Manual: Tabs review](../foundations/checks.md#tabs-review) |
| MUST | Make each tab a `<button type="button">`. | [Manual: Tabs review](../foundations/checks.md#tabs-review) |
| MUST NOT | Use tabs to pick a carousel slide or switch a view mode. | [Manual: Tabs review](../foundations/checks.md#tabs-review) |

Automated checks run on natemills.me before every publish; the scripts live in the private source repository.

## Classes

| Class | Kind | What it does | Tokens it reads |
|---|---|---|---|
| `.tabs` | base | the row; role="tablist" | None |
| `.tabs--lg` | modifier | display-face tabs that head a whole view | None |
| `.tabs--compact` | modifier | mono caption tabs inside a card, each with its own underline | None |
| `.tab` | base | one tab: a <button type="button" role="tab"> | `--border-focus`, `--color-text-primary`, `--color-text-tertiary`, `--duration-fast`, `--ease-default`, `--radius-sm` |

## Tokens

Every token the classes above read, as data from tokens.json: write `var(--name)`, never the raw value. A component token belongs to one component: change it to restyle that component and nothing else. A semantic token is a shared role; never change one for a single component. The three tiers: [Tokens](../foundations/tokens.md#three-tiers).

| Token | Tier | Value | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--border-focus` | Semantic | `2px solid var(--color-focus-ring)` | 2px focus outline; reads --color-focus-ring (ink on light, lime on dark). The keyboard-focus indicator, never removed without a replacement. |
| `--color-text-primary` | Semantic | `#0a0a0b`; dark `#f4f4f5`, from `--neutral-950` | Default reading text. Near-black on light, near-white on dark. |
| `--color-text-tertiary` | Semantic | `#67676f`; dark `#909096`, from `--neutral-600` | Tertiary text: section labels and quiet meta copy; the last step that still clears 4.5:1 on light. |
| `--duration-fast` | Semantic | `150ms` | Hover, focus, and micro state feedback. |
| `--ease-default` | Semantic | `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)` | The workhorse symmetric curve. Begins and ends on screen. |
| `--radius-sm` | Semantic | `8px` | Small radius. The workhorse for inputs and small controls; chips, badges and buttons take the full radius. |
